response.justification: The candidate has genuine geospatial experience (GISCollective, Green Map GIS work) and proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work in DLang at Dunnhumby, which demonstrates relevant systems-programming instincts. However, modern C++ experience is limited and dated (a short 2014–2015 stint), there is no Rust, and recent roles are predominantly TypeScript/Node.js product work. There is no direct routing, navigation guidance, or map-tiling pipeline experience, making this a stretch for a role where C++/Rust and navigation data pipelines are core.
strengths: Hands-on geospatial platform experience (founder of GISCollective, Green Map GIS applications)
Low-latency distributed systems work handling millions of requests/second (async I/O, fibers, caching in DLang)
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, open-source contributions, and Linux/DevOps fluency
concerns: Modern C++ experience is minimal and roughly a decade old; no Rust experience listed
No direct routing, navigation guidance, or map-tile pipeline experience
Recent work (2020–present) is web/product-focused TypeScript/Node.js, not systems-level data pipelines
